If you’re choosing between **DonorDock** and **Keela**, DonorDock appears to be the **simpler, lower-priced option**, while Keela is positioned as a **broader fundraising and donor-management platform** with more advanced capabilities.[2][4][6]

- **Pricing:** Slashdot lists DonorDock at **$49/month** and Keela at **$99/month**.[2]
- **Ease of use:** G2 reports reviewers found DonorDock **easier to use, set up, and administer**.[5]
- **Platform scope:** DonorDock describes itself as an easy-to-use nonprofit CRM with **email, text, project management, and giving pages** in one place.[6]
- **Keela’s positioning:** Keela describes itself as a **complete fundraising and donor management software** for nonprofits.[4]
- **Third-party comparison:** RFP.wiki’s comparison gives DonorDock a slightly higher overall rating than Keela, **4.0 vs. 3.7**.[1]

If your priority is **affordability and simplicity**, DonorDock has the edge.[2][5][6] If your priority is a **more feature-rich fundraising stack**, Keela is the more expansive product based on its own positioning and comparison messaging.[4][7]

If you want, I can also give you a **feature-by-feature comparison** for things like automation, email, reporting, memberships, and integrations.
